name: Ironpalm Press
description: Press the iron palm flat against a foe's chest and let the weight of the stance go through it.

name: Hand Lock
description: Close an iron hand on a foe's wrist and turn it so that the arm is locked straight.

name: Palm Hearing
description: Lay the palm on a post or a foe's armor and hear through metal qi the beat of the body behind it.

name: Palmbreak
description: Drive the iron palm through a foe's raised guard so that the bones of the guarding arm crack.

name: Ironpalm Turn
description: Turn a blade or a spear aside with the flat of an iron palm so that it passes harmlessly by.

name: Palmstun
description: Slap the side of a foe's head or ribs with a ringing palm so that his footing and sight fail for a breath.

name: Flurrying Palms
description: Throw palm after iron palm at one foe in a rapid unbroken run until his guard gives.

name: Bracing Palm
description: Meet a heavy blow with both iron palms braced in front and root the body so that the force goes into the ground.

name: Rending Palm
description: Strike with an iron palm laden with the school's full qi so that plate and body beneath it are torn apart together.

name: Judgement Palm
description: The school's finishing palm: a single still, perfectly weighted strike that the student gives all the qi he can spare, with a force that scales to the student's own grade.

name: Loom Thread
description: Lay the first thread of the loom round a foe's hand or ankle and draw it snug.

name: Warp Flick
description: Flick a strand taut across a foe's cheek or knuckles.

name: Shuttle Dash
description: Dart back and forth between two anchored threads like a shuttle through the warp.

name: Strand Weave
description: Keep a woven sheet of strands before the body to take cuts and thrown weapons.

name: Warpweb
description: Weave a tight web over a foe's arms and legs, drawing the strands in as he moves.

name: Threadcut
description: Pull a strand across a foe's guard in a sawing cut that parts leather and cloth.

name: Weftsense
description: Spread the strands wide through a room and feel through them every body and weapon that touches one.

name: Loom Weave
description: Weave a dense screen that blocks several blows and entangles any weapon that touches it.

name: Silent Snare
description: Leave a web of near-invisible strands across a passage that catches the first to cross and tightens as the others pull.

name: Thousand Strands
description: Loose a thousand strands from the loom at once to cut, tie and sweep every foe inside a wide ring.

name: Loom Dominion
description: The school's finishing weave: the whole space about the student becomes a living loom that binds all foes and cuts those who resist, with a reach that scales to the student's own grade.

name: Plate Knock
description: Rap a grown plate hard against a foe's head or hands to daze him.

name: Plate Fold
description: Fold two grown plates together before the chest so that a blow falls on a double layer.

name: Plate Weighing
description: Weigh a plate in the hand and read how much blow it can still bear.

name: Accreting Plate
description: Grow plate over plate on the arms and chest, thickening with each blow.

name: Plateram
description: Drive a grown plate forward as a ram so that its edge bites and its weight bowls over a foe.

name: Platestep
description: Grow a plate under the foot in mid-stride and push off it a second time in the same step.

name: Stacked Plate
description: Stack many plates in a slow-moving armor that turns the heavier blows of several foes and renews itself.

name: Ingot Hurl
description: Tear a large plate free of the body and hurl it, spinning, at one foe.

name: Plate Avalanche
description: Send a tumbling mass of heavy plates over the foes before the student, crushing and burying what they strike.

name: Undying Plate
description: The school's finishing guard: a plate that is renewed as fast as it is broken, scaling to the student's own grade and ending only when the qi does.

name: Zenith Needle
description: Loose one needle of metal qi straight upward and let it fall onto a foe.

name: Needle Weave
description: Hold a close lattice of needles before the user to turn small missiles aside.

name: Needle Hearing
description: Scatter needles through a space and hear from their ring which have struck flesh, stone or metal.

name: Needle Glide
description: Ride a swarm of needles low over the ground a long pace to the side.

name: Needleveil
description: Whirl a veil of needles before the body that cuts up whatever is thrown at it.

name: Zenithpin
description: Drop a fine pin from above through a foe's helm and shoulder plate.

name: Needlebind
description: Pin a foe's cloak, sleeves and hair to the ground with a rank of needles.

name: Piercingrain
description: Rain fine needles over a broad space at the foes standing there.

name: Needle Lattice
description: Lay a lattice of needles round a space which wounds anyone who moves within it and is felt only by the student.

name: Pin Barrage
description: Unleash needles in endless ranks from the student's hands over a wide arc.

name: Needle Firmament
description: Fill the sky above a wide space with needles like stars and let them fall on every foe beneath over several breaths.

name: Needle Zenith
description: The school's finishing needle: all the student's qi gathered to one point at the zenith and dropped through a single foe, with a reach that scales to the student's own grade.

name: Core Hum
description: Listen to the hum of the Core and read how full it is with metal qi.

name: Core Skin
description: Push the Core's qi out into the skin so that it is hard as bronze.

name: Core Strike
description: Strike with a fist that carries one beat of the Core behind it.

name: Coreward
description: Hold the Core's qi as a ring about the body, ringing against each blow.

name: Coreburst
description: Release a burst of metal qi from the Core in all directions about the user.

name: Spoiling Pulse
description: Send a pulse from the Core into a foe's blow that spoils the flow of his qi.

name: Pinpoint Tap
description: Tap one narrow thread of Core qi into a foe's guard like a driven pin.

name: Resonant Plate
description: Set a plate of metal qi singing in time with the Core so that each strike on it returns a counter-pulse.

name: Resonant Edge
description: Cut with an edge that shakes in time with the Core, so it parts armor that would turn a plain blade.

name: Core Chime
description: Strike the Core like a bell so that a ringing wave goes out and breaks the stance and qi flow of foes in a wide ring.

name: Ironcore Resonance
description: The school's finishing note: the whole Core rung like a great bell of iron, its wave shaking everything of metal and bone within reach, scaling to the student's own grade.

name: Whirl Coin
description: Throw a coin that spins hard and curves round a guard to strike a foe's flank.

name: Coin Cloak
description: Spin a small ring of coins before the body to knock aside darts and thrown blades.

name: Coin Counting
description: Feel the metal in a purse or a belt and tell by its weight and ring what coin and weapons are carried.

name: Coinstorm
description: Fling a handful of coins in a spinning cloud that hits every foe in front of the student.

name: Coinweb
description: Link a ring of coins by thread and cast it round a foe so that it tightens as he moves.

name: Coinlance
description: Stack a line of coins edge on and drive them as one hard lance through a foe's shield.

name: Coinwing
description: Ride a skimming cloud of coins a long pace over broken ground.

name: Golden Cyclone
description: Whirl a cyclone of spinning coins about the student that rakes all within its reach.

name: Coin Aegis
description: Hold a shield of overlapping spinning coins that turns blows and mends its own gaps.

name: Gilded Barrage
description: Loose coins in a ceaseless gleaming barrage, each with a keen edge, at one chosen foe or a line of foes.

name: Coin Maelstrom
description: The school's finishing storm: every coin the student has thrown is called back to whirl in one vast maelstrom, scaling to the student's own grade.

name: Whip Crack
description: Crack the chain-whip across one foe's face with a ringing snap.

name: Whip Guard
description: Spin the whip into a close disc that knocks aside arrows and cuts.

name: Whip Reading
description: Trail the chain over the ground and feel what lies across its path.

name: Whiplash
description: Whip the chain round a foe's guard to strike his back or flank.

name: Whiptwist
description: Twist the chain round a foe's weapon and jerk it out of line.

name: Whipleap
description: Anchor the chain's end on a high point and swing up and across in a long leap.

name: Snaking Whip
description: Weave the chain through a run of strikes that twist and double back on a foe.

name: Wrapping Lash
description: Wrap the chain round the foe in several turns and draw it tight against his strength.

name: Dragon Whip
description: Whip a chain so long and heavy that it lashes a foe, coils round him and drags him in.

name: Chain Dragon
description: The school's finishing chain: the whole chain rears and strikes like a dragon, binding what it strikes, scaling to the student's own grade.

name: Storm Draw
description: Draw the blade so fast that the wind behind it cuts the foe's sleeve.

name: Gust Shield
description: Spin the blade against an arrow or dart so the wind it stirs bears the missile off.

name: Blade Sensing
description: Hold the blade into the wind and feel any other blade or bolt near the student.

name: Gale Lunge
description: Lunge on a push of wind across a pace and a half of open ground.

name: Windblade
description: Loose a thin blade of wind and metal qi at a foe beyond the reach of the sword.

name: Slicing Whirl
description: Wind a whirl of cutting air about the student that diverts arrows and thrown blades.

name: Galewheel
description: Wheel the blade in a full circle so a wheel of wind-edge cuts every foe about the student.

name: Galespear
description: Thrust the blade and send a narrow spear of wind through a foe's shield.

name: Riding Blade
description: Stand on the flat of the blade and let the wind carry the student a long way over a foe's head.

name: Rending Gale
description: Whip up a savage gust full of metal edges that tears all foes in front of the student.

name: Severing Gale
description: Send a single vast blade of wind and metal qi that cuts a line through walls and ranks alike.

name: Storm Reaver
description: The school's finishing storm: a gale of blades the student leads with the sword, reaping all in its path, scaling to the student's own grade.

name: Pull Sensing
description: Open the metal affinity wide and feel the weight and drift of every piece of iron in the near space.

name: Dark Grip
description: Close the pull of the metal affinity round a foe's armor and clamp it to his body.

name: Black Fist
description: Strike with a fist darkened by heavy pull, which draws the foe's armor against the blow.

name: Eclipsebind
description: Dim the metal about a foe with a darkening pull until it clings to him and will not move.

name: Pullstorm
description: Whip every loose piece of metal nearby into a storm that strikes all foes within reach.

name: Metal Drag
description: Drag every thrown piece of metal off its line and into the ground.

name: Eclipseplate
description: Draw a dense dark plate of metal about the body that swallows the force of blows.

name: Dark Lodestone
description: Throw out a heavy dark pull that tears weapons and plate from the foes in front of the student.

name: Eclipse Shield
description: Raise a broad shield of metal drawn from the ground that takes the heaviest blows of many foes.

name: Dimming Pull
description: Draw down the metal qi of a whole company of foes until their weapons are dull and heavy in their hands.

name: Lodestone Eclipse
description: The school's finishing pull: all metal in a wide ring goes dark and still, binding foes in their own gear, scaling to the student's own grade.

name: Endless Draw
description: Cut in a way that leaves the blade already in position for the next stroke.

name: Edge Memory
description: Recall the shape of every cut made by the edge in the last few breaths and read the foe's guard from them.

name: Edge Gliding
description: Slide a pace along the line of a cut with the feet following the blade.

name: Linkcut
description: Link cut to cut in a ring so that each stroke begins where the last ended.

name: Trailing Wave
description: Leave a wave of metal qi behind each cut that flies on at the foe after the blade has passed.

name: Edgeguard
description: Carry a foe's blow round the edge in a looping parry that ends in the student's own cut.

name: Looping Edge
description: Loop the blade through an unbroken run of cuts that never leaves the foe room to answer.

name: Blade Return
description: Turn a foe's own stroke aside and send the blade back along the same line into him.

name: Endless Stroke
description: Cut and cut again without a seam between strokes, each carried by the Core's metal qi, until the foe falls or the qi is gone.

name: Unending Edge
description: The school's finishing cut: one stroke that is never completed and so cannot be turned, scaling to the student's own grade.
